items.title: Spaces model and persistence (terax-spaces.json, serialize/hydrate, boot, debounced save)
items.rationale: User decision 4 (analysis/decisions.md): evolve Spaces into projects (ADR-006); lut-internal schemaVersion only, no Terax data migration. (Analyst: Spaces are the seed of lut projects (PRJ-001, PRJ-002, PRJ-003, PRJ-009, PRJ-011) but the schema is unversioned (store.ts:5-27, no schemaVersion -> PRJ-014), stores no split ratios (serialize.ts:14-16 SerializedNode -> PRJ-006), no profile per pane (PRJ-005), no startup commands (PRJ-004), mixes IDE tabs editor/preview/markdown (serialize.ts:25-27), and conflates preset and live state (PRJ-013, 6.5:2). Replace with a versioned Project/Preset/RunningWorkspace model (F4:1, 6.4) with a one-shot migration from spaces; keep the cold-tab hydration idea and per-entry corruption tolerance (serialize.ts:220-236). Phase 0 renames only the store file (identity:1, F0:10).)
items.risks: Boot errors are swallowed (useSpacesBoot.ts:118-120) so a corrupt store silently yields an empty session; migration must not lose user layouts.

items.title: Space switcher UI (SpaceSwitcher, SpaceAvatar, InlineRename)
items.rationale: Purely visual Terax component; lut needs a project list / switcher (PRJ-001, PRJ-017) designed by the user. The logic it uses (create/rename/reorder/remove in useSpaces.ts:34-40) moves to the projects store.

items.title: Preferences store (terax-settings.json), cross-window sync, zustand mirror
items.rationale: Keep the single-store + writePref/emit cross-window mechanism (store.ts:394-406, 1029-1081; preferences.ts:48-72). Remove AI/editor/LSP/explorer keys (store.ts:233-266, 287-294; 5.10:9, 16:16), rename store file and localStorage shadow keys in Phase 0 (store.ts:225, preferences.ts:17-18; F0:10, identity:1), add schemaVersion + corruption recovery (13.5:9, 16:13) and later layered overrides globalDefaults -> profile -> project (7.1, 6.2:9). terminalShell stays a global preference until profiles (F2:gate, F3:1).
couplings: ~30 consumers of usePreferencesStore across app-shell, terminal, agents, ai, ide-tools (e.g. src/app/App.tsx, src/modules/agents/components/AgentLauncherPanel.tsx:33, src/modules/editor/EditorPane.tsx)
items.risks: Removing keys breaks compile in modules other areas remove; order key removals after ai/ide-tools deletions. No schema version today: unknown keys are ignored, wrong types only partially coerced.

items.title: Settings window entry (settings.html, main.tsx, SettingsApp tab router, openSettingsWindow)
items.rationale: Keep the separate 'settings' webview + ?tab= deep link + terax:settings-tab event (SettingsApp.tsx:86-117, src-tauri/src/lib.rs:88-130) as plumbing; remove models/agents/editor tabs (openSettingsWindow.ts:3-10, SettingsApp.tsx:44,58-63); the layout is replaced after design. Title and prepaint key rebrand (settings.html:7,11).
couplings: app-shell (src-tauri/src/lib.rs:88-130 open_settings_window, lib.rs:252 settings window handling on main exit)

items.title: Settings generic UI (SectionHeader, SettingRow)
items.rationale: Purely visual; replaced by the user's design (UX-004).

items.title: Settings sections lut keeps conceptually (General, Shortcuts, Themes, About)
items.rationale: Visual Terax sections. The settings they edit (terminal renderer/font/cursor/shell/scrollback, agent notifications AGT-010, autostart, shortcuts TER-008, themes UX-004/UX-005/16:6) remain but the UI is redesigned. GeneralSection also hosts explorer settings (GeneralSection.tsx:245-254) that go away. About shows Terax repo/site/bundle id (AboutSection.tsx:11-12,93) -> rebrand (identity:2).

items.title: Settings for the removed BYOK AI (models/providers/keys, AI agent personas)
items.rationale: lut drops in-app AI providers/BYOK keys (ADR-004, 16:16, 9.1). AgentsSection is AI chat personas (AgentsSection.tsx:398), not CLI coding agents.
items.risks: Must land together with or after the ai module removal to keep the build green.

items.title: Editor and LSP settings sections
items.rationale: User decision 2 (analysis/decisions.md): editor and LSP stay as secondary tools; their settings stay and are redesigned with the rest of the settings UI.

items.title: Theme model, provider, application, validation, custom themes store, terminal font
items.rationale: Token-based theme (types.ts:3-66) applied as CSS vars on documentElement (applyTheme.ts:64-102) matches UX-004 and 5.10:9 (reuse tokens). Adapt: drop editorTheme (types.ts:62-65), rename store/localStorage keys in Phase 0 (customThemes.ts:5, ThemeProvider.tsx:47-48), and make the terminal palette resolvable per pane/profile (PRO-005, F3:5, 13.2:19) instead of only per window. UI token names follow the user's design.
couplings: app-shell (ThemeProvider mounted in src/app and src/settings/main.tsx)
items.risks: Per-pane palette needs the renderer to take an explicit palette instead of global CSS vars; must not remount sessions (3.4:invariant, 16:24).

items.title: Built-in theme palettes
items.rationale: Visual palettes incl. terax-default (themes/terax-default.ts:9-11). The user curates lut's built-in themes and default (UX-004, F6:4, identity:2).
items.risks: Persisted themeId 'terax-default' must keep resolving (fallback) when the default theme is renamed.

items.title: Theme file import/edit via the editor (.terax-theme in appConfigDir/themes)
items.rationale: Theme editing writes a file under appConfigDir/themes and opens it in the built-in editor (themeFiles.ts:19-40,120-140; useThemeFileEditing.ts); lut removes the editor. Keep JSON import/export (F6:4, UX-004) and open the file in the OS default editor / watch it instead.

items.title: Editor (CodeMirror) theme resolution
items.rationale: User decision 2 (analysis/decisions.md): the editor stays as a secondary tool, so its theme resolution stays. (Analyst: Only serves the code editor removed by lut (5.10:9).)

items.title: Background image surface (SurfaceLayer, surfaceFrame, IndexedDB bg images)
items.rationale: User decision 16 (analysis/decisions.md): background image is a kept personalisation feature; restyling comes with the redesign. (Analyst: Visual feature (background image layer); whether lut keeps it is a design decision (F6:5). IndexedDB name terax-bg-images (bgImageStore.ts:1) is renamed in Phase 0 while the code exists.)

items.title: Window vibrancy, window activity and live page resize bridges
items.rationale: Platform behaviour (OS backdrop, focus/inactive state, resize smoothing) independent of Terax's look; no terax identifiers. Styling consequences are revisited with the design but the logic stays.

items.title: Workspace authorization registry, launch cwd, WSL helpers, AppImage env (workspace.rs)
items.rationale: Path authorization (workspace.rs:22-270), launch dir (287-340), WSL distro/home/shell (459-750) are needed for pane cwd (PRJ-003), WSL profiles (7.3) and opening projects (PRJ-017). terax strings are only test temp names and an invalid-distro sentinel (workspace.rs:527) -> rename on touch.
items.risks: Project restore must authorize every pane cwd before spawn (as useSpacesBoot.ts:106-107 does).

notes: All plugin-store files are relative to the Tauri app data dir derived from bundle identifier app.crynta.terax (src-tauri/tauri.conf.json:5); localStorage/IndexedDB live in the WebView data dir keyed by the same identifier. Changing the identifier (build-identity) is what actually isolates lut; renaming store files is the explicit F0:10 requirement. No persisted state auto-runs commands today: spaces only store layout+cwd; agentLaunchCommands (settings/store.ts:284) run only on user click (agents/AgentLauncherPanel.tsx:93); editorCustomFormatCommand (settings/store.ts:292) runs a shell template on save (ide-tools, removed). Other stores outside this area: src/modules/ai/lib/{agents,sessions,snippets,todos}.ts use LazyStore too (ai area).
